name: Meteorology
description: The atmosphere and its weather, from the ground up: pressure, density, temperature and humidity, stability, turbulence, altimetry, surface and upper winds, cloud and precipitation, thunderstorms, visibility, icing, air masses, fronts and depressions, world and regional climate, local winds, satellite images, and the reports, forecasts and warnings a pilot reads — METAR, TAF, SIGWX, SIGMET, VOLMET and ATIS.
